tools.name: search_parts
tools.description:
Find spare-part candidates; use search_vehicles for whole cars and get_part to inspect a selected result.

- Combine query/category for the item with make/chassis for its vehicle. Narrow ambiguous item text before relaxing known vehicle identity; a catalogue match never certifies fitment.
- Choose s

tools.name: get_part
tools.description:
Inspect one spare part's price, supply and fitment evidence after search_parts; use prepare_part_handoff for a human enquiry.

- part_id selects one catalogue record, not the OEM-number group. If several records share an OEM reference, select the buyer's intended record before lookup; never combine

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description:
Research retail cars for sale; use get_vehicle for one listing, compare_vehicles for a shortlist or search_auctions to discover auction-event links.

- Combine the buyer's make/model, fuel, model-year range and budget into one shortlist. verified_only narrows evidence quality, not mechanical warrant

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description:
Inspect one car listing's specifications, asking price and inspection evidence after search_vehicles; use compare_vehicles for a shortlist.

- vehicle_id chooses an advertisement. Use the returned canonical listing_id to join its detail, comparison and enquiry; matching make/model or an ID/slug pair

tools.name: get_auction
tools.description:
Read one car auction's current public bid state; search_auctions discovers events and get_vehicle provides the linked car's facts.

- auction_id binds every bid and deadline to one sale event. Keep that event's listing link beside the result; a bid from another event or the car's retail asking price

tools.name: search_auctions
tools.description:
Find auction-event links attached to public cars; use search_vehicles for car specifications and asking prices, or get_auction for one event's bid state.

- Filter the linked car, not the auction title: make='Toyota' with query='Premio' targets that model's vehicle adverts. Unpriced cars remain elig

- vehicle_ids chooses the adverts to include, in buyer-selected order; it does not rerun search filters. Resolve ID/slug aliases to distinct listing_id values. Repeating an advert must not creat

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_auction" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read one car auction's current public bid state; search_auctions discovers events and get_vehicle provides the linked car's facts. - auction_id binds every bid …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_parts, search_vehicles · Private data: get_part, get_vehicle, get_auction, search_auctions · Public sink: get_part, prepare_vehicle_handoff, prepare_part_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_parts, search_vehicles · Private data: get_part, get_vehicle, get_auction, search_auctions · Public sink: get_part, prepare_vehicle_handoff, prepare_part_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_parts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
